property_summary: For any caller who is the depositor account and any basefee value, setL1BlockValues must not alter the stored basefee state (it remains 0); the mutant stores _basefee, so basefee() becomes nonzero for some fuzzed input.
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _basefee into the state variable basefee after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public basefee() getter.
